informal_statement:
Let real \(x,b,c,s\) satisfy \(s\geq0\),
\[
b\leq c,
\]
\(c\geq0\), and
\[
c\leq b+\sqrt{s}.
\]
Then
\[
|x|\leq b+\sqrt{s}
\]
is equivalent to
\[
-c\leq x\leq c,
\]
or
\[
(x+b)^2\leq s
\]
with
\[
x\leq-c,
\]
or
\[
(x-b)^2\leq s
\]
with
\[
x\geq c.
\]
